text.card: A red giant 3,971 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.88 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,795 K at its surface.
